concepts.label: Cluster backup (Cloud Snapshot)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted in upgrade-best-practices.json, this batch

concepts.label: Cross-region cluster backup copy (up to 2 additional CSP regions)

relations.subject: backup:cluster-backup
relations.evidence: You have the **Project Owner** role for the project with the cluster you want to back up. If you have the **Organization Owner** role, you have Project Owner permissions.

relations.subject: backup:cross-region-backup-copy
relations.evidence: If your cluster uses Couchbase Server version 7.6.6 or later and is deployed on AWS or Azure, you can choose to replicate your backups to 2 regions, other than the region where your cluster is deployed... Cluster backups for GCP clusters cannot be replicated to additional regions.

relations.subject: backup:cluster-backup
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (behavesDifferentlyUnder) - restates the 500-snapshot Azure cap in the scheduling-UI context
relations.evidence: Azure limits your total number of incremental backups to a maximum of 500. After 500 incremental snapshot backups, Azure starts using full cluster backups and your cluster backup costs will greatly increase.

relations.subject: backup:cluster-backup
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (seeAlso) - cluster backups can also be created/scheduled via the Management API, not only the UI
relations.evidence: To take a cluster backup from the Capella Management API, see [Create Cloud Snapshot Backup](../management-api-reference/index.md#tag/Cloud-Snapshot-Backups-and-Restore/operation/createCloudSnapshotBackup).

relations.subject: backup:cluster-backup
relations.evidence: For more information about how to restore a cluster backup, see [Restore a Cluster Backup](restore-cloud-snapshot.md).

notable_absence.finding: No support-plan gate on taking or scheduling a cluster backup - Project Owner/Organization Owner is the only access-control axis, matching every other backup surface in this batch. The default retention values stated here (7 days on-demand, every-4-hours/7-days scheduled) are plan-agnostic defaults, not tier-dependent limits - no free-tier or paid-tier distinction is drawn for cluster backups on this page (contrast with manage-backup.json, where BUCKET backups are explicitly unavailable in the UI on free tier - this page draws no equivalent distinction for CLUSTER backups).

cross_component_finding: This page's silence on a free-tier restriction for cluster backups (as opposed to manage-backup.json's explicit 'Backup options are unavailable in the UI for your free tier operational cluster' for BUCKET backups) is itself informative - it suggests the free-tier UI restriction found on the bucket-backup surface may not extend to cluster (Cloud Snapshot) backups, or that this page simply doesn't address the free-tier case. Not resolved here; flagged for the reconciler to check against a free-tier-specific cluster-backup page if one exists.
